item.title: What is analogue paneer, and why is FSSAI cracking down on it? | Explained
item.description: Analogue paneer is not necessarily an illegally adulterated product merely because it is an analogue. FSSAI has recognised “Analogue in Dairy Context” as a category. The regulatory concern arises when such a product is represented to consumers as conventional paneer or another dairy product

item.title: Changing culture of movie-watching
item.description: From iconic single screens to multiplexes, streaming platforms and movies watched at home, Hyderabad’s cinema culture has changed dramatically over the years. Theatres that once anchored neighbourhoods have shut, others have reinvented themselves, and the meaning of ‘going to the movies’ has shifted. Yet the appetite for films and the pull of a shared big-screen experience remains, writes Naveen Kumar

item.title: Covering the bases: from visibility to votes
item.description: Last year, the Congress set in motion the Sangathan Srijan Abhiyan, a process of rewiring its district leadership across India. This year, Rahul Gandhi is undertaking a renewed push towards public engagement bordering on activism, even as district leadership is being freed of past hierarchies. Sandeep Phukan examines the social re-engineering of the grand old party and how it intends to build up to the 2029 Parliamentary election
